notes.title: SELMA AND THE WISP SALE
notes.content:
[h3]A unique opportunity to discover the dark world of Selma.[/h3]

Imagine you were alone and afraid.
Imagine you were lost with no one to help.
Imagine you were a child facing its worst nightmare.
In utter darkness even the dimmest trickle of light means hope.

[previewyoutube=OPDN1qkaYBY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: PGA Awards 2016 - Best Indie Game
notes.content:
Selma and the Wisp has been shown at Poznan Game Arena 2016. Our title got an award Best Indie Game. In verdict committee emphasized astonishing art style and great gameplay. Thank you.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25801742/1c9bdef0dce789d96dbe96946fb3020170ee7487.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Autumn Nightmare Update
notes.content:
[h1]New update of Selma and the Wisp is already available! We prepared for you a bunch of new features so get ready to play and explore an eerie land with Selma and the Wisp.[/h1]

An update includes:[list]
[*]Steam cloud integration
[*]13 new languages available
[*]Upgraded artificial intelligence of Selma
[*]New achievements
[*]New secret locations in the game
[*]Nightmare mode 
[*]Minor bugs fixed[/list]

Follow the wisp. Collect the lights. Don’t look back.

notes.title: Update + Linux + Mac OS X
notes.content:
[h1]New update is here. We added intro and now Selma and the Wisp is available also on Linux and Mac OS X.[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Intro added
[*]Better Selma movement
[*]Better switching gamepad to mouse
[*]Changed default graphics settings from very low to high.
[*]Linux version.
[*]Mac version.
[/list]

[b]Levels[/b]
Level 1
[list][*]Removed crawling under the bridge.[/list]
Level 2
[list][*]Fixed camera zoom on mill.[/list]
Level 3
[list][*]Fixed going up the platforms over the trap with rising waters.[/list]
Level 4
[list][*]Added laser sound and changed shooting frequency.[/list]
Level 5
[list][*]Fixed conveyors placement.[/list]
Level 6
[list][*]Crows more often attack and cross the cables.
[*]Plasma in restaurant does more damage.[/list]
Level 7
[list][*]Fixed bug with wisp flying through the floor.[/list]
Level 8
[list][*]Selma can walk across all fountain.
[*]Fixed movement over the cars.[/list]
Level 9
[list][*]Fixed falling rocks.
[*]Fixed bug with wisp flying through balloon.[/list]
